spec.description:
Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for Claude Code CLI usage. Track sessions, tokens, costs, commits, pull requests, lines of code, and developer productivity metrics. Compatible with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir, and Thanos.

Metrics required:
- claude_code_session_count_total
- claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total
- claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total
- claude_code_active_time_seconds_total
- claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total
- claude_code_commit_count_total
- claude_code_pull_request_count_total
- claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total

For metric collection setup via Grafana Alloy, see: https://github.com/hionnode/spawn-claude

spec.title: Active Time
spec.description: Time breakdown: 'cli' = time Claude Code is processing, 'user' = time waiting for user input

spec.title: Tokens by Type
spec.description: Token usage by type: input (prompt), output (response), cacheRead (from cache), cacheCreation (added to cache)

spec.title: Tool Decisions
spec.description: Tool edit decisions: 'accept' = user accepted the edit, 'reject' = user rejected the edit

spec.title: Cost Over Time
spec.description: Estimated cost rate over time (USD per hour)

spec.title: Cost by Model
spec.description: Cost breakdown by Claude model (e.g., claude-opus-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5)

spec.title: Token Usage by Type
spec.description: Token consumption rate by type (input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreation)

spec.title: Token Usage by Model
spec.description: Token consumption rate by Claude model

spec.title: Sessions Over Time
spec.description: Number of Claude Code sessions started over time

spec.title: Active Time (per hour)
spec.description: Active time per hour: 'cli' = Claude Code processing time, 'user' = user interaction time

spec.title: Lines of Code (per hour)
spec.description: Lines of code modified by Claude Code per hour

spec.title: Tool Decisions Over Time
spec.description: User decisions on Claude Code tool suggestions (accept vs reject)

spec.title: Top Users by Cost
spec.description: Top 10 users ranked by total cost in the selected time range

spec.title: Top Users by Tokens
spec.description: Top 10 users ranked by total token consumption

spec.title: Top Repos by Cost
spec.description: Top 10 repositories ranked by total cost

spec.title: Cost Distribution by Model
spec.description: Cost distribution across different Claude models (totals over selected time range)

spec.title: Tool Usage by Language
spec.description: Distribution of tool usage across programming languages

spec.title: Sessions by Terminal
spec.description: Distribution of sessions across terminal types (VS Code, iTerm, etc.)

spec.title: Total Cost
spec.description: Total estimated cost in USD based on token usage and model pricing

spec.title: Cache Hit Rate
spec.description: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache (cacheRead / (input + cacheRead)). Higher = lower cost. Cached input tokens are ~10% the price of fresh input.

spec.expr: sum(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{organization_id=~"$organization", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model", marlin_git_repo=~"$repo", type="cacheRead"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{organization_id=~"$organization", user_email=~"$user", model=~"$model", marlin_git_repo=~"$repo", type=~"input|cacheRead"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Tool Accept Rate
spec.description: Share of Claude Code edit-tool decisions accepted by the user. Low values mean Claude is being overridden; high values mean its edits are landing unchanged.

spec.title: Cost per Session
spec.description: Total cost divided by number of sessions in the selected time range. A quick benchmark for how expensive an average Claude Code session is running.

spec.title: API Request Rate
spec.description: Rate of claude_code.api_request log events per interval. Each event is one Anthropic API call and carries duration_ms, cost_usd, input/output/cache tokens, model, and speed attributes (inspect via the Recent Events panel below).

spec.title: User Prompts Rate
spec.description: Rate of claude_code.user_prompt events per interval. Each event carries prompt.id, prompt_length, terminal.type, and the (redacted) prompt text.

spec.title: Tool Event Rate (decision vs. result)
spec.description: Rate of tool lifecycle events. tool_decision = user accept/reject on any tool (Bash, Edit, Read, WebFetch, Task, ...). tool_result = tool execution outcome, carries success=true|false, duration_ms, and tool_result_size_bytes. Compare the two to spot tool failures.

spec.title: Recent Events
spec.description: Raw claude_code.* log stream from Loki. Filter with the built-in search box; drill into individual events to see attributes like tool_name, success, duration_ms, model, cost_usd, prompt_length.

spec.title: Total Tokens
spec.description: Total tokens consumed including input, output, cache read, and cache creation tokens

spec.title: Commits
spec.description: Total git commits created using Claude Code

spec.title: Pull Requests
spec.description: Total pull requests created using Claude Code

spec.title: Lines Added
spec.description: Total lines of code added by Claude Code

spec.title: Lines Removed
spec.description: Total lines of code removed by Claude Code

spec.title: Claude Code Metrics
